en.name: Spelt flour
en.summary: Spelt flour keeps 3 months in the pantry and 6 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Spelt is an ancient wheat usually milled wholemeal, so the germ's oil is what sets the limit rather than anything microbial.
en.pantry: 3 months in an airtight container on a cool, dark, dry shelf. Spelt is generally sold wholemeal or lightly sifted, which keeps the bran and germ and gives it the sweet, nutty flavour people buy it for — and puts oil in the flour. Warmth, light and air drive that oil to oxidise, so an opaque tub in a cupboard beats a paper bag on an open shelf by a wide margin. Fresh spelt smells sweet and nutty; a stale bag smells sharp and faintly of oil paint, and the bitterness carries into the loaf.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for spelt flour. The fridge slows the oil and is a workable middle option for a bag you will bake through over a season, provided the container is genuinely airtight — wholemeal flour takes up moisture and fridge smells easily, and a cold bag opened in a warm kitchen condenses water into the flour. If the freezer has room, use it instead.
en.freezer: 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and this is the sensible default for a bag larger than a season's baking. Use an airtight tub or a double bag with the air pressed out, and label it — one wholemeal flour looks like another once frozen. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well past that; what runs out is flavour as the oil oxidises slowly even cold. Let the sealed container reach room temperature before opening, and let the flour warm before mixing: spelt gluten is fragile and a cold, stiff dough is easier to overwork.
en.thawing: Bring the sealed container up to room temperature before opening so the flour does not take up condensation, and let the flour warm before you mix a dough.
spoilage: A sharp, oily or paint-like smell — rancid germ oil.
A bitter aftertaste in a bake that used to work.
Clumping or a hard cake in the bag, which means moisture got in.
Webbing, larvae or small moths, in which case the bag goes out.
tips: Decant into an opaque airtight tub as soon as you open the bag.
Buy what you will bake through in a season.
Handle spelt dough gently — its gluten is more fragile than modern wheat's.
Freeze a new bag hard for a couple of days to kill weevil eggs.

faq.q: How long does spelt flour last?
faq.a: 3 months in an airtight container in the pantry, or 6 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Seal it airtight, label it, and let it come back to room temperature before opening.

faq.q: How do you tell if spelt flour has gone off?
faq.a: Smell it. A sharp, paint-like note means the germ oil has gone rancid, and the bread will taste bitter.

zh.name: 斯佩爾特小麥粉
zh.summary: 斯佩爾特小麥粉密封放常溫可放 3 個月，−18 °C 冷凍是 6 個月。它是古老小麥，通常以全麥形式研磨，所以決定期限的是胚芽油脂，而不是任何微生物。
zh.pantry: 裝密封罐、放陰涼避光乾燥的架子，3 個月。斯佩爾特通常以全麥或輕篩的形式販售，保留麩皮與胚芽，帶來那股大家為它買單的甜香堅果味——同時也把油脂留在粉裡。熱、光和空氣會推動油脂氧化，所以「不透光密封罐收在櫃子裡」遠勝「紙袋擺在開放層架上」。新鮮的斯佩爾特粉聞起來甜而帶堅果香；走味的一袋則刺鼻、微帶油漆味，而那股苦會跑進麵包裡。
zh.fridge: 斯佩爾特粉沒有公布的冷藏期限。冷藏能拖慢油脂，對一季內會烤完的份量是可行的折衷，前提是容器真正密封——全麥粉很會吸濕也很會吸冰箱的味道，一包冰過的粉在溫暖廚房裡打開，水氣會凝進粉裡。如果冷凍有空間，請改放冷凍。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 6 個月；超過一季用量的話，這就是合理的預設。用密封罐或套兩層袋、壓出空氣，並貼標籤——全麥粉冷凍起來長得都一樣。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；先用完的是風味，因為油脂在低溫下仍會慢慢氧化。開蓋前先讓整罐回到室溫，調麵團前也讓粉回溫：斯佩爾特的麵筋很脆弱，冰冷又硬的麵團更容易被打過頭。
zh.thawing: 整罐密封著回到室溫再開蓋，粉才不會受潮；調麵團前也先讓粉回溫。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、帶油味或油漆味——胚芽油耗了。
一向沒問題的配方卻出現苦的餘韻。
袋子裡結塊或結成硬餅，表示受潮。
出現絲網、幼蟲或小蛾，整袋丟掉。
tips: 拆封後立刻倒進不透光的密封罐。
買一季內烤得完的份量。
斯佩爾特麵團要輕手操作——它的麵筋比現代小麥脆弱。
新買的整袋先冷凍凍硬兩三天，把蟲卵殺掉。

faq.q: 斯佩爾特小麥粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放常溫 3 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 6 個月。

faq.q: 斯佩爾特小麥粉可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 6 個月。密封、貼標籤，開蓋前先讓它回到室溫。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷斯佩爾特小麥粉壞了？
faq.a: 聞一下。刺鼻、像油漆的味道就是胚芽油耗了，烤出來的麵包會發苦。
